basic_info.description: Luxury, Service, Location. Residence #22E has refreshed interiors offering a luxurious move-in condition lifestyle overlooking San Francisco's world renowned Union Square. The Four Seasons defined luxury city living when it opened in 2001 and has continued to elevate the homeowner experience through high touch concierge service, discreet security, and an unrivaled amenity package. This 2 bedroom condominium has been configured to accommodate open plan entertaining, intimate den seating, and a spacious master suite.  A bistro kitchen with counters for barstool seating. Ebony hardwood floors in the living area and plush wall to wall carpet in the spacious bedroom.  Built-in window seating throughout to watch dramatic sunsets over the downtown skyline. Granite and marble counters, designer lighting fixtures, top of the line appliances. Valet parking.
